rationale.consistency: Uses time.Duration instead of caddy.Duration in the Timeouts handler struct, limiting JSON config to integers instead of string durations.
rationale.edge_cases: Route-level timeouts are overwritten by server-level idle timeouts due to the nested wrapping order, and route timeouts bypass server hard timeouts.
rationale.scope: Implements all requested functionality (idle timeouts, chunking, rates, Caddyfile support) exactly as specified with no unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: The code is exceptionally clear and includes excellent explanatory comments for the subtle chunking and Hijack logic.
rationale.robustness: The creditFor cap of math.MaxInt64 overflows time.Duration when added to d.Timeout, which abruptly kills very large transfers with low MinRate.
rationale.maintainability: Properly modularizes the timeout logic by encapsulating state into Reusable IdleDeadline and clean wrapper structs.
